---
title: "Candidate models specification"
---

`cand_models` is a mutable, pipeline-compatible continuous-regression card after
`cand_train`. It consumes all completed compatible tuning evidence, not a
score shortlist. A dynamic `navset_bar` contains Overall and method tabs; one
persistent FigureWidget outside the panels renders a three-axis Scatter3d.
Navigation never changes the Overall export. Camera `uirevision` is stable.

The double-handle footer slider maps a,b in [0,100] to weights a,b−a,100−b.
Initial weights are 100,0,0. Client callbacks update labels while dragging and
publish `WeightCommit` only on release. The normal slider value is persisted.
The derived commit input and navigation/inspection controls are excluded from
configuration. Qualitative interpretability is displayed. Candidate methods are eligible by default; the retired EligibleMethods input is ignored and excluded from saved state.

`candidate_selection` computes three-dimensional nondomination and log-space WPM.
RMSE/MAE losses and P95 are minimized; throughput is maximized. R² uses 1−R².
The visible positive ErrorFloor guards zero losses. Missing active criteria exclude
trials, inactive missing criteria do not. Exact utility ties prefer nondominated
trials, then primary score and stable ID. Per-method decisions use their own full
eligible evidence. RMSE/MAE is displayed diagnostically and has no decision weight.

Export attaches Overall and per-method trial IDs in `tuning_results.review`, then
uses `with_selected_model(..., card='cand_models')` to select the full unfitted
Overall pipeline. No ensemble or final fitting occurs. The proxy helper preserves
its existing default record identity for `model_candidates`. Historical read-only
results cannot select pipelines; changed-source readiness gates export. Empty or
ineligible decisions pass the incoming pipeline through. Winner IDs are derived,
not trusted as replay instructions. Raw weights/floor inputs persist.

The flip side reuses the existing comparison semantics, selected-row inspection,
parameter labels, auto-opening details and standard 220px Download button.
Tests cover weighting boundaries, unit conversions, zeros, missing evidence,
R² transformation, Pareto ties, all-trial eligibility, full pipeline selection,
WebKit chart/tab/weight interactions and retired-filter restoration and widget reuse.

The 3D scene and axis planes use the standard #bbd6f8 background with white
gridlines and transparent paper. Frontier circles use size 6 and opacity 1;
dominated circles use size 4 and opacity .65, both with dark outlines. The winner
is a black size-11 diamond with a white outline. These styles encode status, not
viewing distance or complexity. Quarto help defines dominance and tab-local
frontiers and separates frontier membership from weighting and uncertainty.


`UsuallyTransparentOnly` is a visible, guided, persisted checkbox, default false.
When true, the selection eligibility frame includes only methods with reviewed
`usually_transparent` estimator-level catalogue metadata. Resolve the exact
terminal class from shared pipeline templates where available; otherwise an
exact saved catalogue method/recipe identity supports historical review. Do not
infer from display names, class-name substrings or tuned depth. Unknown identity,
conflicting aliases and all other transparency statuses fail closed. No native
estimator imports or fitting are needed for this constraint.

Apply eligibility before method navigation, chart/frontier, weighted decisions,
comparisons and CSV export. The complete tuning evidence remains unchanged.
Record `usually_transparent_only` in review metadata; no eligible trials produce
no selected winner and explanatory text. Bookmark restoration recomputes winners
using the restored constraint, rather than trusting stale saved winners. The
existing intrinsic transparency classifications do not certify preprocessing
interpretability, causal meaning or post-hoc explanation quality.
